//counts: Measured 2026-10-10 after routing the scribe into SOAP: 2185/1443/735/7 with NO database, and 2185/2180/0/5 against a local PostgreSQL 17.10. +3 over the consent-gate figures, all three database-free, so the SKIPPED ceiling did not move. Client 346. THE RULE DID NOT CHANGE; IT MOVED TO THE RIGHT PLACE. The scribe used to draft the Subjective and nothing else, on the rule that a model drafting an assessment is a model making a clinical decision. That rule stands. What was wrong is WHERE it sat: when a pharmacist says out loud "chest is clear, looks viral, honey and fluids, come back in five days", the assessment and the plan were MADE BY A PERSON, and writing them into the right boxes is transcription. Refusing was not safety, it was making a pharmacist retype a decision they had already spoken. So the line moved from WHICH SECTION to WHOSE WORDS: the patient’s voice drafts Subjective and nothing else, the pharmacist’s drafts Objective, Assessment and Plan, and a voice that said nothing drafts nothing. The structured records (problems, interventions, referral, prescription, care-program, summary) stay forbidden, and now for a sharper reason: they are not prose but records with their own validation and their own audit trail. ONE model call with both halves labelled, because the owner asked for swift and this deployment’s model reasons for seconds - but the labelling is a HINT and each section is then validated against the words of the person who owns it, so a model that files the pharmacist’s advice as the patient’s report is caught rather than trusted. A NEW REFUSAL, hardenedACertainty: an assessment that drops a hedge the pharmacist used. "I think it MIGHT be viral" filed as "Viral upper respiratory infection" has turned a working impression into a diagnosis and the next reader cannot tell. Asked only of the Assessment, because that is the section where certainty IS the clinical content. WITHINTRANSCRIPT BECAME A RATIO, and this is a LOOSENING named as one. The first live run refused the Subjective as longer_than_transcript at 462 characters from 444 of speech - FOUR PER CENT over, on the normal case, for the most important section. Measured: subjective 1.04, objective 0.21, assessment 0.24, plan 0.44, because the Subjective covers ALL of a patient’s speech while the others cover part of the pharmacist’s. Capped at 1.5 now. It still catches a model answering a short recording with paragraphs; it never caught a fabricated symptom that fits inside the budget, at any threshold, because that is SHORTER - which needs entity-level grounding and has its own task. Six mutations run against the new safety logic and all six turned the right test red. TWO EXISTING INVARIANTS WERE AMENDED WITH THE PRODUCT, NOT RELAXED. scribeContract’s pinned SCRIBABLE === [subjective]; it now pins the stronger claim that every section is drafted from the voice that owns it AND that a forbidden section has no owning voice at all. consultationLayout’s microphone invariant pinned an early return the mode machine replaced; it now pins REACHABILITY - the microphone is opened in exactly one place, that place renders only under mode ready, and ready is reachable only via a consented note or the server’s own acceptance of consent.

//lastChange: The scribe writes the whole SOAP note (2026-10-10, owner’s decision). Patient’s voice -> Subjective; pharmacist’s voice -> Objective, Assessment, Plan; a voice that said nothing drafts nothing. Measured end to end against the live model on a realistic eleven-turn consultation: 8.3s, nothing refused, the pharmacist’s questions appearing NOWHERE, the patient’s symptoms staying out of Objective, and the hedge surviving into the assessment ("Most likely a viral upper respiratory infection; it might just be the dust..."). The screen now opens with a real choice - "With voice" and "Type it", side by side and the same size, with a test asserting typing is never described as a fallback, because an interface that makes voice the obvious path will push somebody into recording a patient who did not want it. Primary is design.md’s near-black fill, never emerald. Recording is carried by MOTION, not red: design.md reserves red for a person waiting on a human, and a static mark replaces the pulse under prefers-reduced-motion. TWO BUGS THE BROWSER FOUND: the two choice cards were crushed because the media query asked how wide the WINDOW was while the cards sit in a column that also gives 215px to a sidebar and 260px to the context panel - auto-fit asks how much room is actually here, measured 1 column at 413px and 2 equal columns at 816px; and the running API was still answering with the OLD response shape, caught by checking the contract rather than assuming it, which is exactly how the public WhatsApp number field saved nothing for a month. DEAD CODE LEFT BEHIND: draftSubjective and scribe() in scribe.js are no longer called by anything. Their comments were corrected to name the live function so they do not mislead, but removing them is its own change.
